decision_basis: Owner-confirmed contributor-first priority, English, WeChat/Instagram, peer voice, and future review-reward direction. Exact reward mechanics, creative, and launch remain pending.

audience.segment: Current students and alumni with firsthand university experience, wherever they live. Begin with the founder's student network.
audience.need: Help the next student with a candid account and receive a useful thank-you when the planned reward launches.

objective: Increase genuine, useful, detailed university reviews first; sign-ups and filled profiles are supporting outcomes.
offer_or_value: Help future students understand real university life. Future planned thank-you: 2GB of VPN data for a full or approximately 90%-complete review, images optional. Not yet available or approved for announcement.
core_message: Tell the next student what your university is really like, with a useful thank-you for the time you put in.

claims.wording: Share your university experience on TRC.
claims.limitations: Review route exists in repository; live device/network flow still needs testing.

cta.network_and_device_notes: Test intended WeChat and other device/network journeys, including guest submission, account claiming while remaining anonymous, and future reward delivery. Do not promise untraceability or an unverified signed-in anonymous toggle.

distribution.community_permission: Owner has a WeChat group and will use student groups. Confirm permission/rules for each group.

deliverables.variant_hypothesis: A specific dorm-life prompt may be easier to answer than a broad request.
Showing how one practical detail helps a future student may make contribution feel worthwhile.

creative.selected_angle: Owner direction: make the useful reward prominent without burying the mission. Final hook/layout still to select; no live reward announcement before readiness.
must_include: A direct invitation explaining whom the review helps
One contribution CTA, not a paid-plan upsell
If the future reward is advertised, prominent 2GB allowance, eligibility, availability, provider relationship, and delivery terms
Anonymous reviews eligible; no required public social handle
Accurate account-versus-public-identity explanation for the verified journey
must_avoid: A paid-plan upsell in the same asset
Guaranteed anonymity or safety from identification
Mandatory photos, invented detail, or pressure to be positive

commercial.partner: Founder reports a friend's single-location VPN server; fulfillment and terms not finalized.

measurement.definition: Finalize a useful-detail definition before counting qualifying reviews. Do not equate existing site detail labels with the pending approximately 90% reward criterion. Exclude demo, known spam, duplicates, and deleted content.
measurement.data_source: Confirm existing aggregate outcome reporting before launch.
secondary_metrics: Profile completion under a separately agreed definition
quality_guardrails: Negative and anonymous reviews eligible on the same detail standard
Fulfillment email is not automatic provider-marketing consent
measurement.attribution_method: Undecided. Do not claim campaign-level attribution from an overall count.

open_questions: What is the first creative format and founder presence?
Which review details define the approximately 90% threshold without requiring photos or irrelevant answers?
How will 2GB redemption, expiry, provider capacity, duplicate prevention, and email delivery work?
Is any profile-linked discount still wanted, and on what terms?
Can intended users complete the relevant anonymous/account journey on their actual network?
What existing aggregate data can measure outcomes without new sensitive tracking?
